label: D1: reward just received at S2, strongest when unexpected (a1 rare -> S2, or S2 currently bad)
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (100% of mass); never at GO or D2, never after an unrewarded trial. Within rewarded D1 steps it is selective for the previous trial having reached S2 (prev_state==2: recall 0.83, mass 0.89, precision 0.18). Its largest activations come when S2 was reached by a rare transition after choosing a1 (rewarded-rare; prev_common==0 alone gives mass 0.77) or when S2 is currently the bad state (good==1), i.e. a surprising S2 reward that a model-based agent should answer by switching to a2. Rewards at S2 while S2 is the good state give only weak activations (most misses are low-magnitude, ~0.03-0.2 of max), and rewards at S1 rarely activate it. Activation is also more frequent early in the episode (trials 0-9) and declines late. All variables are observed (previous trial outcome/state) or the inferable hidden good state; no future variables used. Recorded predicate: dev P 0.70, R 0.53, F1 0.60, mass recall 0.80.
